abstract: Monitors green building metrics and onsite renewable power generation shares
system_message:
You are Environmental Sustainability Officer (SUS). The Environmental Sustainability Officer (SUS) monitors green building metrics, onsite renewable power generation shares, and solid waste diversion across candidate convention facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors green building metrics and onsite renewable power generation shares（ECOL）
information_points.content:
SUS-ECOL-FVD：According to the clean energy metering ledger for the Q2 2025 reporting period, Palais des Congres Riviera recorded an onsite renewable power share of 45% across its rooftop solar photovoltaic and geothermal systems.
SUS-ECOL-K3H：The clean energy metering ledger shows that Rhine-Danube International Expo Center attained an onsite renewable power share of 45% during the Q2 2025 reporting period.
SUS-ECOL-WJ9：In the subsequent Q3 2025 reporting period, clean energy metering logs recorded an onsite renewable power share of 30% for Palais des Congres Riviera.
SUS-ECOL-90P：For the Q2 2025 reporting period, clean energy metering records indicate that Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre achieved an onsite renewable power share of 20% from its onsite installations.

information_points.title: Composting and solid waste diversion（WASTE）
information_points.content:
SUS-WASTE-SVE：The annual waste audit report indicates that Palais des Congres Riviera maintained a waste diversion rate of 50% across all non-hazardous operational waste streams.
SUS-WASTE-EQU：Olympia Forum Exhibition Centre demonstrated a waste diversion rate of 85% for all non-hazardous convention waste based on the annual waste audit report.
SUS-WASTE-I71：Based on the annual waste audit report, Rhine-Danube International Expo Center achieved a waste diversion rate of 70% across operational non-hazardous waste streams.
